team_pick: Optional, trial. At character creation the team gets one free shared pick: a Lair, or any one Asset. Nobody spends a slot on it. After that, the Lair and Assets grow through Advancement.

basics.name: Rest
basics.text: At Dawn there, Sleep It Off clears 1 more Stress and Patch Up clears 1 more Harm.

basics.name: Lie low
basics.text: A hero who picks Lay Low there can't be found until the next Night: no Dawn move, ambush or arrest lands on them.

basics.name: Meet
basics.text: The team can plan, hold a prisoner for a scene, and keep evidence there, out of sight.

styles.name: Gym
styles.what: A boxing gym, a dojo, a basement full of weights
styles.text: It adds a Dawn pick, Train: spend one of your two picks there and start the next Night with 1 more Drive.

dawn_pick.name: Train
dawn_pick.text: Start the next Night with 1 more Drive.

styles.name: Hideout
styles.what: A sewer junction, a dead subway station, a boarded-up cellar
styles.text: Hard to find. The first time the Lair would be found, it isn't: the threat comes to nothing.

styles.name: Front
styles.what: A bar, a repair shop, a clinic with a back room
styles.text: A public face that covers for you. Once per case, when one hero's Home clock would tick, it doesn't.

styles.name: Watchtower
styles.what: A clock tower, a water tank, a penthouse nobody rents
styles.text: It looks out over a neighborhood. Once per Night, Edge on one lead roll there.

rooms.name: Crime lab
rooms.text: Once per Night, spend a scene on physical evidence and take 1 clue, no roll. It counts as the team's one no-roll clue. Gear that was taken from you is replaced by the next Night.

rooms.name: Med bay
rooms.text: It clears a Dying mark at Dawn. A hero who was Dying and stabilized clears Down here with Patch Up alone.

rooms.name: Garage
rooms.text: Needs a Vehicle. A wrecked Vehicle is fixed by the next Night, with no Dawn spent. Once per case, the Vehicle starts a chase with one hit already scored.

rooms.name: Workshop
rooms.text: At each Dawn there, one hero swaps one piece of gear for another of the same cost, and one smashed piece of gear is repaired.

rooms.name: Monitor room
rooms.text: Once per Night, the GM tells the team where the next Scheme beat will land. Nobody ambushes the team in the Lair.

rooms.name: Holding cell
rooms.text: Hold one captured named enemy between Nights. Interrogating them there has Edge. Someone will come looking for them.

lair.found: When it is found, every hero who uses the Lair ticks Home by 2. From then on the villain can strike there, as a Scheme beat or a Patrol move. It stays found until the team moves it, which costs each hero one Dawn pick.
lair.burned: Burned: gone for the rest of the case, rooms and all. When the case closes, the team sets up somewhere new and keeps its rooms.

assets.name: Vehicle
assets.text: One extra Patrol action per Night, Edge in chases, and once per Night it can crash into a fight as an entrance (move your whole group into any zone, and one mook group drops). Wrecking it costs a Dawn to fix.

assets.name: Network
assets.text: Once per Night, take a free lead with no cost. Ignore them too long and they start asking for favors.

assets.name: Crime lab
assets.text: Once per Night, spend a scene on physical evidence and take 1 clue, no roll. It counts as the team's one no-roll clue. Gear that was taken from you is replaced by the next Night.

assets.name: Back-alley clinic
assets.text: It clears a Dying mark at Dawn. A hero who was Dying and stabilized clears Down here with Patch Up alone.

assets.name: Safe house
assets.text: Lay Low clears 2 Heat instead of 1. Once per case, burn an identity to ignore 1 Heat you would take.

assets.name: Inside man
assets.text: Once per Night, Edge on a lead that runs through police or city records, and using those records adds no Heat. When Heat fills, the team picks the Crackdown instead of the GM.

assets.name: Home turf
assets.text: In your neighborhood, enemies can't ambush the team, and you can Vanish in a Crowd there with Edge. Once per Night there, the cops arrive a round late.
